Name: Aimeroids
Overview:
Aimeroids is a space based shooter game similar in concept to the game Asteroids. Gameplay involves the players spaceship flying around an asteroid field blowing up asteroids without getting hit around the head by one. The player will also have passing alien ships to contend with by blowing them up as well.

There are two game modes available, the first is called "Retro", and is the basic shot the rock version with no strings attached. The second is called "Powerplay", which is largely the same as Retro, only now the player has access to power ups that can aid them such as shield upgrades and improvements to the players weapons.
